title: Correct final expression
description: Essential: The final answer must be mathematically equivalent to T = mg / (2 cos θ).

title: Vertical force balance
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply equilibrium in the vertical direction, stating that the sum of vertical components of tension equals the weight mg.

title: Tension component resolution
description: Important: The solution must correctly resolve the tension into vertical components, using the given angle θ (not 2θ) relative to the vertical or horizontal.

title: Free-body diagram logic
description: Optional: The response may include a clear free-body diagram or equivalent verbal description identifying all forces on the acrobat-unicycle system.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The final answer may be presented with correct units or a statement about dimensional consistency.

title: Angle misinterpretation
description: Pitfall: Using the full angle 2θ incorrectly in the cosine function (e.g., using cos(2θ) or sin(θ) where cos(θ) is required) is a common error.

title: Missing equilibrium condition
description: Pitfall: Failing to state or apply the condition of static equilibrium (net force equals zero) is a fundamental error.
